rows.name: Metagenomi Therapeutics, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: A preclinical in vivo hem-A editor with monkey-only data faces Novo's SC prophylaxis first; $140M cash is 5x the $28M cap, but it is a value trap until human FVIII data.

rows.name: Genmab A/S
rows.indication: Ovarian cancer (the nearer-term of Genmab's two 2026 re-rating catalysts)
rows.pitch_concise: Up 102% in six months to a $33.4B cap, ~9x the $3.6B peak estimate; Rina-S's 45.9% ORR in open-label Ph1/2 is good, but the pipeline wins already look capitalized.

rows.name: Estrella Immunopharma, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: A 100% CR rate in n=9 at one month is not interpretable, and $0.15M cash against $9.3M liabilities on a $22M cap makes the dilution cliff the real event.

rows.name: Exicure, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: Burixafor met its mobilization primary (89%), but a $6M cap, $3M cash, going-concern doubt and a Nasdaq equity deficiency make survival, not a supportive-care niche, the issue.

rows.name: Karyopharm Therapeutics Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: SENTRY hit SVR35 (49.8% vs 28%) but missed the TSS co-primary with Grade 3+ AEs 70% vs 50%; with $91M cash dwarfing a ~$1M micro-cap, the SVR-only sNDA is a cheap binary on the FDA.

rows.name: Actinium Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: ATNM-400 is a preclinical Ac-225 prostate asset with no human data facing entrenched Pluvicto, and the market gives it little ($52M cap vs $42M cash); wait for the IND.

rows.name: TScan Therapeutics, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: Not a data story but a cash discount with ~4 quarters to burn: a preclinical in vivo PRAME/MAGE-A4 pivot after a 75% layoff and a paused heme Ph3, at a $12M cap vs $100M cash (0.12x).

rows.name: Elicio Therapeutics, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: The Ph2 missed its ITT DFS primary and the R0 subgroup (HR 0.65, p=0.048) is nominal; $24M cash vs a $37M cap means a Ph3 needs financing the data may not support.

rows.name: Oncolytics Biotech Inc.
rows.indication: 2L KRAS-mutant MSS metastatic colorectal cancer (lead, REO 033); 2L+ metastatic anal cancer (SCAC, Fast Track, earlier stage)
rows.pitch_concise: ~30% ORR vs ~14% historical in anal cancer and FDA alignment on a pivotal are real, but $5M cash against a $55M cap makes financing the first event; high-risk, funding-gated.

rows.name: Actuate Therapeutics, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: A randomized 1L pancreatic survival win (HR 0.62, n=233) at a $7M cap, but $4M cash and a going-concern warning make dilution the real event; a high-risk lottery ticket.

rows.name: RenovoRx, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: Interim mOS 16 vs 10mo (p=0.051) leans positive with enrollment done and topline 2H27, so the short carries squeeze risk; the $16M peak estimate is still 0.3x the $53M cap.

rows.name: Revolution Medicines, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: Daraxonrasib doubled 2L PDAC survival (OS HR 0.40) and is approved, but the $39.9B cap already capitalizes ~6.3x the $6.3B peak estimate; 1L data and launch uptake are the swing.

rows.name: Tvardi Therapeutics, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: The H2 HCC topline is binary: only biomarker/PK data, a hard STAT3 history and a going-concern flag mean a stock trading at about its $16M cash is no floor.

rows.name: Kyntra Bio, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: FG-3246's 21% composite response is weak, so this is a below-cash value long rather than an efficacy bet; $87M cash is 5.8x the $15M cap, so failure is already priced.

rows.name: Radiopharm Theranostics Limited
rows.nick: RAD101 hit Ph2b primary endpoint 93% concordance w/ MRI (n=30 evaluable) Jul 22 2026; advancing to Ph3 Q4 2026; addressable market ~$600M+, no approved PET competitor
rows.pitch_concise: A $3.3B cap on $4M cash and a $27M peak-sales estimate (~124x) is the crux; a niche imaging agent at 93% MRI concordance cannot carry that, and a raise looks imminent.

rows.name: Telomir Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: A preclinical metal chelator with zero human data: the $36M cap is still 72% of the $50M peak estimate on only $6M of cash, so dilution comes well before any clinical proof.

rows.name: Atossa Therapeutics, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: A 26.5% breast-density cut matching tamoxifen is a biomarker, not an outcome, and financing may precede EVANGELINE data; a cash-backed show-me story, trading below $26M cash.

rows.name: LeonaBio, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: ELAINE-1 missed significance (HR 0.70, p=0.14) and thin runway means a raise first, but with the $33M cap below its $51M cash into a 2H27 Ph3 it is a cash-backed option on ~13mo combo mPFS.

rows.name: Context Therapeutics Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: 29% confirmed ORR vs ~10% historical in pretreated ovarian cancer with Fast Track is the draw, backed by $55M cash, 3.2x the $17M cap; Ph1 size and mid-2027 runway are the caveats.

rows.name: Avere Therapeutics Inc. (merged with NextCure, Jul 2026; new ticker AVRX)
rows.pitch_concise: The pending Avere merger leaves legacy holders ~2%, so the real bet is a late oral IL-23 entrant with Ph2b data ~1H 2028, whatever the screen shows from a $29M cap vs $400M cash.

rows.name: CEL-SCI Corporation
rows.pitch_concise: A striking 73% vs 45% five-year OS in a PD-L1-low subgroup is post-hoc salvage after the broad trial missed, and $2M cash makes the 212-patient confirmatory Ph3 a financing question first.

rows.name: BeyondSpring Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: DUBLIN-3's HR 0.82 and a 49% PoS make a $26M cap look cheap, but with $8M cash and ~3.6 quarters of runway, the confirmatory DUBLIN-4 is a financing event before it is a data event.

rows.name: Lantern Pharma Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: A $6M cap against $6M cash buys an FDA-aligned single-arm L858R study (8.3mo mPFS vs 3-5mo for chemo), but ~2 quarters of runway makes dilution near-certain; option value only.

rows.name: Apollomics, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: ORR of 64.5% (85.7% at GCN>=4) is competitive with capmatinib's ~68% and the drug is China-approved, but $3M cash (the CEO lent $2M) puts financing ahead of the H1 2027 US IND.

rows.name: Immutep Limited
rows.indication: Neoadjuvant soft-tissue sarcoma + PD-L1-negative (CPS<1) head & neck squamous cell carcinoma (refocused strategy)
rows.pitch_concise: After the NSCLC Ph3 stopped for futility and the market doubts the manufacturing fix, STS data (51.5% vs ~15%) is the show-me; $99M cash is 3.8x the $26M cap, with 2.2 quarters of runway.

rows.name: Evaxion A/S
rows.pitch_concise: 75% ORR (n=16) with 92% still responding at 2 years is cheap option value against a $25M cap mostly backed by $18M cash, but a tiny n and Merck/Moderna's mRNA-4157 lead cap conviction.

rows.name: OS Therapies Incorporated
rows.pitch_concise: A rolling BLA on ~40 single-arm patients (3-yr OS 71.2%) with ~$1M cash and 0.1 quarter of runway; the $35M cap is ~2.3x the ~$15M weighted peak (20% x $75M), so avoid.

rows.name: Pliant Therapeutics, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: 1 CR and 2 PRs in n=16 ICI-refractory patients (vs ~10% historical) earn nothing, with cash 3.4x the $50M cap; the Mar-2027 Ph1b interim is the re-rate in a crowded space.

rows.name: INmune Bio Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: MINDFuL missed its clinical primary (biomarker hit only, p=0.0028), and going-concern risk plus a partner-needed Ph2b/3 make this financing-gated option value; cash is 64% of the $33M cap.

rows.name: Pelthos Therapeutics Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: ZELSUVMI revenue of $15.4M (+45% QoQ) against a $28M cap, ~0.1x the $345M peak estimate; with $32M cash and $30M drawn on its credit facility, the capital structure is the whole debate.

rows.name: EyePoint Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: LUGANO missed and LUCIA is do-or-die with AXPAXLI ahead, so at ~2.6 quarters of runway the cash gets burned before it can be returned, even at 7x the $31M cap after a 97% collapse.

rows.name: Kalaris Therapeutics, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: The cap is 0.4x cash for an aflibercept-based TH103 with +10 letters in n=13, but AXPAXLI, DURAVYU and 4D-150 are all at Ph3; the cash buys the option until MAD data in mid-2027.

rows.name: Palatin Technologies, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: Going-concern doubt on $7.5M cash against a $10M cap, preclinical MC4R programs and Rhythm's IMCIVREE years ahead: dilution arrives before any Ph1 start.

rows.name: Aldeyra Therapeutics, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: Three CRLs on field-trial reproducibility and no resubmission date make the cash the only real asset ($65M, 1.8x the $36M cap); avoid until the FDA dispute resolves.

rows.name: Nasus Pharma Ltd.
rows.pitch_concise: Faster PK than EpiPen (T100 1.69 vs 3.47 min) is real, but with $0 cash and a pivotal still to fund, the $35M cap is ~2x its $17M probability-weighted peak; dilution comes first.

rows.name: Jasper Therapeutics, Inc. (merged with Kira Pharmaceuticals, 2026)
rows.indication: PNH; IgA nephropathy; C3G (rare renal/complement basket)
rows.pitch_concise: KP-104 is priced near zero before the reported $132M post-merger placement ($15M cap vs $14M cash); PNH Ph2 data are due year-end, but Fabhalta is years ahead.

rows.name: Adicet Bio, Inc.
rows.indication: Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), with or without lupus nephritis
rows.pitch_concise: A 7-patient allogeneic CAR-T lupus signal stays intact and is cash-backed ($138M, ~5x the $28M cap); slipped data timing and durability are the risks.

rows.name: Connect Biopharma Holdings Limited
rows.indication: Acute COPD exacerbations with Type 2 inflammation (lead); acute asthma exacerbations (secondary, endpoint missed)
rows.pitch_concise: The COPD Ph2 hit (81% fewer treatment failures, p=0.0122) but asthma missed, and a $45M cap on $44M cash with 2.9 quarters of runway means dilution before any Ph3. Avoid.

rows.name: ImageneBio, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: The Ph2b slipped a full year to Q4 2027 after enrollment tripled and the only efficacy data are uncontrolled, so a $46M cap against $117M cash is not enough of a discount.

rows.name: Enlivex Therapeutics Ltd.
rows.pitch_concise: A randomized Ph1/2a hit (47% pain reduction, p=0.0001) with RMAT, and the $25M cap is ~0.15x the $167M weighted peak, but $6M cash and a crypto-treasury pivot add risk.

rows.name: SCYNEXIS, Inc.
rows.indication: Vulvovaginal candidiasis (BREXAFEMME, approved) + invasive candidiasis/fungal-infection prevention (SCY-247, BARDA-funded)
rows.pitch_concise: BREXAFEMME royalties are negligible ($0.2M license revenue in Q2) and the MARIO Ph3 was terminated, so $71M cash at 2x the $34M cap is cheap for a reason until the early assets read out.

rows.name: Seres Therapeutics, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: A 77% cut in bloodstream infections in allo-HSCT (Breakthrough) at a $14M cap, below $18M cash, but ~1.5 quarters of runway and an unfunded pivotal Ph2 make it a financing-gated option.

rows.name: Aligos Therapeutics, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: Going-concern language into Q4 2026 means the long needs financing before the 2027 topline of a ~231-patient active-controlled Ph2 that is fully enrolled; cash is 4.2x the $13M cap.

rows.name: Tevogen Bio Holdings Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: Financing and listing risk swamp any Long COVID pivot: $1M of cash on a $37M cap, a Nasdaq compliance notice and n=12 uncontrolled Ph1 data.

rows.name: Decoy Therapeutics Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: Hamster-only data (~4-log viral reduction), no human trial until 2027 and 3.5 quarters of runway make this a melting ice cube, not a floor, though cash exceeds the $3M cap.

rows.name: NanoViricides, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: Zero human efficacy data, $3M cash (~1.6 quarters) against a $33M cap, and an Ebola/mpox pivot that adds headlines rather than evidence; dilution is the base case.

rows.name: Mereo BioPharma Group plc
rows.stage: Phase 3 completed (missed primary endpoint); regulatory pathway discussions ongoing
rows.pitch_concise: Setrusumab raised BMD in both Ph3s but missed on fractures, the endpoint that matters; a $44M cap near $36M cash is a shell with an unfunded alvelestat Ph3 and a case on secondary data.

rows.name: Edesa Biotech, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: Positive Ph3 ARDS mortality result (24% vs 33%, p<0.001, n=278) at a $28M cap below $33M cash after an 88% drop; the open question is whether FDA accepts it or demands a confirmatory trial.

rows.name: MiNK Therapeutics, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: A randomized ARDS Ph2 reads out in 2H26 and a win would dwarf a $51M cap, but $10M cash (3.5 quarters) means any pop is likely funded by dilution; binary with a financing tail.

rows.name: Rein Therapeutics Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: A full clinical hold, enrollment of only >25% of n~120 and an underpowered Ph2 mean interim data cannot settle efficacy; avoid until RENEW enrolls, though cap roughly matches $44M cash.

rows.name: Aardvark Therapeutics, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: A full cardiac clinical hold and a terminated HERO Ph3 leave no live program, and VYKAT already owns the PWS label; a value trap until a path emerges, despite cash at 3.1x the $29M cap.

rows.name: Biomea Fusion, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: COVALENT-211 (Q1 2027) must be financed before it reads out, given a pulled September offering and runway only into Q2 2027; upside is a $42M cap vs $324M probability-weighted peak.

rows.name: eXoZymes, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: A successful 100-liter pilot run is manufacturing progress, not drug development; with a preclinical compound, $6M cash (1.2 quarters) and a $38M cap, dilution is the near-certain event.

rows.name: Veru Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: QUALITY (n=168) preserved lean mass on semaglutide (p=0.002) and a $36M cap is 0.1x the $357M probability-weighted peak, but going-concern flags and an add-on role make financing the gate.

rows.name: iBio, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: An AI-engineered anti-myostatin entering Ph1 with safety/PK data in Q1 2027 has no human efficacy, so the cash backing is the thesis, not the pipeline; cap is 0.6x the $75M cash.

rows.name: Incannex Healthcare Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: Its Ph2 (n=121, only 14-41% meaningful responders) trails Apnimed's AD109 and a dose-optimization study delays Ph3; constructive only as cash-backed, at 0.4x its $70M cash.

rows.name: Filana Therapeutics, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: A repurposed Cassava drug with mouse-only TSC data is a value trap; lifting the clinical hold does not create a human signal, even with cash ($51M) at 2.2x the $23M cap.

rows.name: Grace Therapeutics, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: A CMC-only CRL leaves a Ph3-complete IV nimodipine at a $37M cap, ~10x below 66% x $562M of peak; $17M cash is 46% of the cap, so the speed of the Type A fix and financing decide it.

rows.name: Acumen Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: ALTITUDE-AD, a 542-patient Ph2, reads out in late 2026 for a lower-ARIA anti-amyloid backed only by Ph1 plaque reduction of 20-25%; $79M cash with 2.9 quarters of runway makes this a binary.

rows.name: Annovis Bio, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: Going-concern doubt and 0.8 quarters of runway ahead of an 850-patient Ph3 reading out after Jan 2027 mean dilution before data; a subgroup-only Ph2/3 (n=117) cannot carry that.

rows.name: ProMIS Neurosciences, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: PRECISE-AD is fully enrolled (144) with zero ARIA-E at the 6-month blinded look, while unblinded efficacy has slipped to early 2027; cash of $64M is 2x the $32M cap.

rows.name: CervoMed Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: Best signal in DLB (54% lower CDR-SB worsening risk, p=0.0037), but Ph3 now depends on a partner and $25M cash lasts 4 quarters; the $23M cap is cheap only if financing does not eat it.

rows.name: Gain Therapeutics, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: Uncontrolled Ph1b biomarker data (n=21) and 2.9 quarters of cash against a Ph2 that slipped to 1Q27 and is still unfunded; the IND clearance is real, but the next event is a raise.

rows.name: IGC Pharma, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: Almost no cash (about 0.1 quarter of runway) ahead of the CALMA topline; an interim CMAI -10.45 at p=0.071 is borderline, so dilution risk outweighs a $19M cap.

rows.name: MIRA Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: No human efficacy yet for an oral ketamine analog in a field of failed CIPN programs, with going-concern language and a Ph2a not yet dosed; $8M cash is 29% of the $28M cap.

rows.name: Dogwood Therapeutics, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: A Nov 30 Ph2b topline (217 enrolled; interim 51% vs 35% responders) is a binary for a $33M cap with only 2 quarters of runway; a win re-rates, but the financing comes with it.

rows.name: Tonix Pharmaceuticals Holding Corp.
rows.pitch_concise: Tonmya is ramping (Q2 $11.0M, +197% QoQ), yet 3.8 quarters of runway at a ~$40M quarterly burn means financing, not demand, sets the path; cash of $163M is 3.1x the $52M cap.

rows.name: Scilex Holding Company
rows.pitch_concise: Distressed: $3M cash against a $12M cap, a stockholders' deficit and the SEMDEXA NDA slipped to 2027; the 77% drop does not make it cheap, since dilution or insolvency is the base case.

rows.name: Vistagen Therapeutics, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: Two straight Ph3 misses (PALISADE-3 and -4) and 2.4 quarters of runway say the cash will be spent on another try, not returned, despite $32M being 4.6x the $7M cap.

rows.name: Aytu BioPharma, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: EXXUA scripts ramp (200 to 920 a month, Jan-Apr), but total revenue fell 33% and breakeven is not reached, so launch pace must outrun dilution; $27M cash exceeds the $20M cap.

rows.name: Lipocine Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: The PPD Ph3 missed its ITT primary and the rescue is a post hoc subgroup (n=54) with litigation overhang, so $23M cash at 1.8x the $13M cap is cheap for a reason.

rows.name: Reviva Pharmaceuticals Holdings, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: Strong Ph3 (-10.1 PANSS vs placebo, p<0.001) and $22M cash vs a $4M cap, but a flagged ~$35M funding gap and a mandatory RECOVER-2 make the equity an option on financing.

rows.name: Serina Therapeutics, Inc.
rows.pitch_concise: Once-daily SC apomorphine faces AbbVie's Vyalev, with Ph1 SAD data only in 1H27; $25M cash is 71% of the $35M cap, but convenience-only differentiation and dilution risk say pass.

rows.name: Talphera, Inc.
rows.indication: Anticoagulation of the CRRT (continuous renal replacement) circuit
rows.pitch_concise: A 70-patient CRRT Ph3, 75% enrolled, is the entire story, and thin cash looks tight to finish it; a $53M cap vs $150M probability-weighted peak is tempting but financing comes first.
